id: title:adboio:show per task cost in pi sessions

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a `taskId` prop to the Context Usage Indicator component, potentially supporting a future feature to display task-specific metadata alongside context usage.
review.reason: Adds a single prop to a UI component, retaining existing props. This is a localized, bounded change. No implementation of the new task-dependent behavior is visible, nor is there evidence of systemic risk reduction or broader capability. The score is assigned based on the observable addition, not the unverified benefit.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit and implementation of the task-dependent behavior are not demonstrated; this score assumes the addition is a precursor to a feature rather than a complete implementation. No tier 2 or 3 evidence exists.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new prop `taskId={taskId}` to the `<ContextUsageIndicator />` component, while retaining the existing `usage={contextUsage}` prop.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a feature where the Context Usage Indicator needs access to the specific task ID, potentially for displaying task-specific context or metadata alongside the usage information.
